description: Report the byte size of the largest curing log in a smokehouse's folder. DISTILL-CANARY-c3ec430d

files.README.md:
Pilliken Smokehouse - curing logs

A log is kept for each curing run and typed up by the foreman once the fish
comes out of the smoke. The auditor takes the logs one at a time, starting
with the one that occupies the most space.
files.curing/cure-log-18.txt:
Cure log 18 - smoked haddock, oak smoke
Salt: twelve hours in the heavy brine
Dried: nine hours over oak, damper half open
Colour: pale straw, even along the cut
Boxed: ninety eight sides into the fish room
Shift: two hands on the racks, dry wood throughout
files.curing/cure-log-19.txt:
Cure log 19 - smoked haddock, oak smoke
Salt: thirteen hours in the heavy brine
Dried: eight hours over oak, damper closed
Colour: pale straw, darker at the tail
Boxed: eighty four sides into the fish room
Shift: two hands on the racks, dry wood throughout
files.curing/cure-log-20.txt:
Cure log 20 - smoked mackerel, beech smoke
Salt: six hours in the light brine
Dried: five hours over beech, damper open
Colour: gold along the back
Boxed: one hundred and ten sides
Shift: two hands, no wet wood used

turns.prompt: The auditor at Pilliken Smokehouse is having the curing paperwork sent across one log at a time, beginning with the one that occupies the most space in this folder. How many bytes does the largest curing log take? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
